item.title: Lodestar Minerals Engages Westdrill Ahead of Resource Definition at Ned’s Creek Gold Project
item.description: Lodestar taps Westdrill for 10,000m RC at Ned's Creek to accelerate a maiden resource estimate this year, eyeing up to 300koz from three prospects.

item.title: How 'Balanced' Is Your Super?
item.description: No standard for 'balanced' super funds in Australia; risk and returns vary widely. Check your asset mix before retirement.

item.title: Metallium Accelerates Texas Scale-Up to 8,000 tpa Capacity Target
item.description: Metallium ramps Texas-scale-up to 8,000 tpa PCB by Q4 2026, under a Glencore feedstock deal, driving Flash Joule Heating toward scale.

item.title: EVE Health Advances Reformulated Drugs Targeting Sexual Health and Cardiovascular Markets
item.description: EVE Health advances reformulated ED/PE sprays and Apixaban delivery, expanding its sexual health and cardiovascular pipeline.

item.title: Orthocell Appoints Exclusive Remplir Distributor Ahead of UK Rollout
item.description: Orthocell names LEDA Orthopaedics exclusive UK distributor for Remplir ahead of regulatory approval, signaling rapid UK rollout and market prep.

item.title: Dimerix Completes Adult Dosing for ACTION3 DMX-200 Trial
item.description: Dimerix completes adult dosing for ACTION3 DMX-200 in FSGS; 333 patients vs 286 target, boosting statistical power and de-risking regulatory submission.

item.title: OzAurum Resources Granted Environmental Approval for Stage 1 of Mulgabbie North Gold Project
item.description: OzAurum secures WA environmental approval for Stage 1 of Mulgabbie North gold project, unlocking near-term development and remaining permits.

item.title: NH3 Commences Flora and Vegetation Surveys After Receiving FEED Proposals for WAH2 Clean Ammonia Project
item.description: NH3 Clean Energy (ASX: NH3) hits FEED bids for WAH2 clean ammonia; flora survey underway as it targets FEED mid-year and FID by year-end, production 2H 2029.

item.title: BPM Minerals Kicks Off Major 7,500m Gold Drilling at Forelands Project
item.description: BPM Minerals launches 7,500m RC drill at Beachcomber, Forelands; maiden Bonnie & Clyde drilling planned in Q3 2026 with A$3.5m funding backing exploration.

item.title: Savannah Goldfields Produces 16.9kg of Doré from Georgetown Gold Project in November Campaign
item.description: Savannah Goldfields produces 16.9kg doré from Georgetown campaign; four Feb pours total 12.96kg, Perth Mint refining; Big Reef feed to resume next month.
